# Kenya Fund Finder

> Independent comparison platform for Kenyan unit trust funds, equities, FX rates, commodities, and market news. Daily-updated yields and prices for Money Market, Fixed Income, Equity, Balanced, and Bond funds regulated by the Capital Markets Authority (CMA) of Kenya.

Kenya Fund Finder helps investors track and compare collective investment schemes in Kenya. The site is informational only — it does not provide investment advice, broker services, or fund transactions. Yields shown are gross annual effective yields before the 15% withholding tax unless stated. All data is sourced from publicly available fund fact sheets and regulatory filings.

## Pages

- [Unit Trusts](/): Live table of Kenyan unit trust funds with annual yields, manager, fund type, and minimum investment.
- [Funds](/funds): Full unit trust listings.
- [Stocks](/stocks): Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) listed equities with live prices.
- [FX Rates](/rates): Live foreign exchange rates against the Kenya Shilling (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.).
- [Commodities](/commodities): Gold, oil, and crypto spot prices.
- [Markets](/markets): Terminal-style mobile market dashboard.
- [Overview](/overview): Cross-asset market overview.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side fund comparison.
- [Calculator](/calculator): Investment returns, currency, and KRA PAYE calculators.
- [News](/news): Investment fund and market news for Kenya.
- [Alerts](/alerts): Personalized price-alert management.
- [Learn](/learn): Educational guides on unit trusts, risks, returns, and CMA regulation.
- [Checklist](/checklist): Pre-investment checklist for Kenyan investors.
